title: Sharp Continuity of Petz and Sandwiched Rényi Conditional Entropies
summary: We determine the sharp modulus of continuity, in trace distance, of the optimized Petz and sandwiched Rényi conditional entropies for every order $α\in[\frac12,1)$. If two bipartite states are within trace distance $δ$, then both conditional entropies differ by at most $\frac{1}{1-α} \log[(1-\varepsilon)^α +(D-1)^{1-α}\varepsilon^α]$, where $\varepsilon := \min\{δ,1-1/D\}$ and $D$ is the effective dimension, given by the dimension of the first subsystem times the largest possible Schmidt rank.
